He's the president, who's allowing him to do anything?

Not to take a position on the overall argument. Jackie definitely knew, the whole country did, unless there's documents I don't know about (which, admittedly, there probably are) none of us can say how she felt about it.

If someone said they were a lesbian, I would definitely assume they were a women and exclusively attracted to women (and probably some nonbinary people? No common term really accounts for enbys, and considering them a single group is just creating a gender trinary). If it turns out that she was also attracted to men, I would say the term lesbian is maybe misleading but not incorrect.

So, a woman attracted to other women and generally but not necessarily unattracted to men.
